entry_points.summary: Prints claude|pi|codex|cursor|antigravity; first positive-marker wins; claude is unconditional default; never prints unknown or empty
Z_HARNESS_HOST overrides; else detect-host.sh called once and cached to /tmp/zh-host-$PPID; host stamped on every event
Emits subagent_call event; non-fatal (always exits 0); fields: role, subagent_type, subagent_model, prompt_chars, response_chars, optional provider_*_tokens
Per-host, per-subagent_type cost breakdown; weights prompt_chars vs response_chars by per-model rates; labels char-est vs real-tokens
CI check: greps Agent( dispatch sites; fails if any site lacks log-subagent.sh call or # no-subagent-log: <reason> opt-out

invariants: detect-host.sh never prints unknown or empty; claude is unconditional default
host is stamped on every event by log-event.sh; callers never stamp it themselves
host resolved lazily once per $PPID process via /tmp/zh-host-$PPID sentinel
log-subagent.sh always exits 0; subagent telemetry never blocks a dispatch
prompt_chars and response_chars are always separate fields; single collapsed est_tokens is never emitted (D9)
provider_input_tokens / provider_output_tokens are optional; absent for native Claude subagents
test_subagent_logging.sh fails CI on any Agent( site without paired log call or explicit opt-out
gotchas: Z_HARNESS_HOST overrides detection entirely; useful in CI where env markers are absent
host sentinel keyed on $PPID not $$; each bash log-event.sh call is a new process
passing empty string for --provider-input-tokens is equivalent to omitting; payload builder skips falsy values
char-est rows in /z-stats output are not directly comparable to real-tokens rows; ~4-char/token heuristic applies
drift-guard opt-out comment must be exactly '# no-subagent-log: <reason>' — any deviation is flagged
for native Claude Agent() subagents prompt_chars/response_chars are character counts NOT token counts — real provider_*_tokens only available from external CLIs that print a usage line
